in_sanskrit.name: सरस्वता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The flowing one. Goddess of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning.

in_hindi.name: सरस्वता
in_hindi.long_meaning: प्रवाहित होना या प्रवाहित होने वाला। ज्ञान, संगीत, कला, बुद्धि और सीखने वाली देवी।

in_tamil.name: சரச்வதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஓடும் அல்லது ஓடும் வாலி. கல்வி, சங்கீதம், கலை, புத்துவினை மற்றும் கற்றல் கடவுள்.

in_telugu.name: సరస్వత
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఓడిపోయింది అథవా ఓడిపోయింది వాలి. జ్ఞానం, సంగీతం, కలా, బుద్ధి మరియు శిక్షణ దేవత.

in_marathi.name: Saraswatha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of knowledge and wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saraswatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Saraswatha is the Hindu goddess of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning. She is depicted as a beautiful woman with four arms.

in_bengali.name: Saraswatha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of knowledge and wisdom
in_bengali.long_meaning: Saraswatha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Saraswatha is the Hindu goddess of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning. She is depicted as a beautiful woman with four arms.
